title: How to check a harness in two minutes
lines: Read the label: standard number, year of manufacture and serial number.
A CE mark alone is not enough. Next to it you need a four-digit number of a notified body.
Check stitching, webbing and buckles. A cut, burn or rust means the harness is out.
A harness that has arrested a fall is retired, even if it looks fine.
And a competent person signs the periodic inspection.
